drhp.business: The Company is exclusively engaged in the business of clothing and clothing accessories, constituting one single operating segment under Ind AS 108. It controls the entire gamut of operations from fabric sourcing, manufacturing and retail, selling premium menswear (and related categories) through three brands — Zodiac, Zod and z3 — with both brick-and-mortar stores and its online store completely owned and operated by the Company.
drhp.expansion: The Company ended the year with 71 stores across 37 cities, having disciplined retail expansion as part of its growth strategy. Initiatives from the previous year continued to build the premium menswear franchise: Principe (the Made-to-Order Programme) was extended to over half the stores in the Zodiac chain after initial success at select stores; Carletti, the super-premium ready-to-wear shirt line, was made available exclusively at Zodiac's flagship stores.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continued focus on operational excellence and process simplification to navigate an evolving global landscape.
- Digital agility through data analytics and Artificial Intelligence leveraged across the value chain — from demand forecasting and inventory management to consumer engagement.
- Strengthening presence across both traditional and digital retail channels to remain accessible to consumers.
- Prioritising brand-led full-price sell-through and superior quality over margin-diluting discounting.
